metric_definitions.days_below_half: days on which fewer than half the present keys are usable
metric_definitions.days_zero_usable: days on which no key at all holds a usable value
metric_definitions.median_daily_share: median over days of (usable rows / rows present that day)
metric_definitions.pooled_share: usable rows over the whole window / rows over the whole window
